scope: Single-tool Cartesian RepRapFirmware slicer envelopes only. These dimensions do not establish controller wiring, probe reach, motor order or firmware compatibility.

big-180x.name: BIG-180X
big-180x.note: Conservative 600 mm Z envelope from the Modix catalogue and Generation 4 specification. The current web comparison also advertises 660 mm; do not silently enlarge older machines.

big-meter.name: BIG-Meter
big-meter.note: 980 x 1000 x 1000 reference. Older/upgraded installations may have less travel; adjust the local printer preset to match the machine.

everest.name: Everest
everest.note: Excluded from the 2.9.6 starter bundle: PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 restricts max_print_height to 1200 mm. Keep the real 2000 mm dimension here instead of publishing a false envelope.
